records.source: There's a twinkle in Wizard's eye...
records.translation: May kislap sa mata ng Mago...

records.source: For those aware of the esoteric mysteries, that had deep significance...
records.translation: Para sa mga nakababatid sa mga hiwagang esoteriko, napakalalim ng kahulugan niyon...

records.preserveReason: The line contains only an ellipsis indicating silence and has no lexical text to translate.

records.source: You pulled me from my studies for *this*?
records.translation: Inilayo mo ako sa aking pag-aaral para *rito*?

records.source: The newspaper gave this one '5 stars', so I'm willing to give it a go.
records.translation: Binigyan ito ng pahayagan ng '5 bituin', kaya susubukan ko.

records.source: Heh! That was actually pretty good! Thanks for inviting me.
records.translation: Heh! Maganda pala talaga iyon! Salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin.

records.source: Hmph... Theaters aren't like they used to be... But the picture might be good enough.
records.translation: Hmph... Hindi na gaya ng dati ang mga sinehan... Pero baka sapat naman ang ganda ng pelikula.

records.source: Heh. Compared to most movies these days, it wasn't bad.$h
records.translation: Heh. Kung ihahambing sa karamihan ng mga pelikula ngayon, hindi iyon masama.$h

records.source: Hmph... I'll take a nap during this one.
records.translation: Hmph... Matutulog na lamang ako habang pinapalabas ito.

records.source: Shameful! The trash they pass for 'movies' these days...
records.translation: Kahihiyan! Basura ang tinatawag nilang 'pelikula' sa panahon ngayon...

records.source: This one's supposed to be pretty funny, I'm looking forward to it.
records.translation: Nakakatawa raw ito. Sabik na akong mapanood.

records.source: Hah! I really liked it. But I dunno if I could survive on gluten pucks like that.
records.translation: Hah! Talagang nagustuhan ko iyon. Pero hindi ko alam kung mabubuhay ako sa mga diskong gluten na gaya niyon.

records.source: I've been wanting to see this one for a while. Thanks for the ticket, @!
records.translation: Matagal ko nang gustong mapanood ito. Salamat sa tiket, @!

records.source: That was great! My legs are still tingling with the excitement.
records.translation: Napakaganda niyon! Nanginginig pa rin sa pananabik ang mga binti ko.

records.source: Hey, I'm pretty excited to see a movie! I'm gonna need a snack, though...
records.translation: Hoy, sabik akong manood ng pelikula! Pero kakailanganin ko ng meryenda...

records.source: Hey, that was pretty good. Thanks for inviting me to this, @.
records.translation: Hoy, maganda naman iyon. Salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin, @.

records.source: This movie seems kind of nerdy, but I'll give it a shot.
records.translation: Mukhang masyadong pang-utak ang pelikulang ito, pero susubukan ko.

records.source: I can't tell if that was boring, or if I'm just not smart enough to understand it...$s
records.translation: Hindi ko malaman kung nakababagot iyon o hindi lamang ako sapat na matalino upang maunawaan iyon...$s

records.source: Before this theater came to town, I hadn't seen a movie in twenty years!$h
records.translation: Bago nagkaroon ng sinehan sa bayan, dalawampung taon akong hindi nakapanood ng pelikula!$h

records.source: I loved it... now you know why '{0}' is considered a classic.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto ko iyon... alam mo na ngayon kung bakit itinuturing na klasiko ang '{0}'.

records.source: It's very kind of you to invite an old lady to the movies.$h
records.translation: Napakabait mong anyayahan ang isang matandang babae sa sinehan.$h

records.source: I'm glad they're still making decent movies... I had a lot of fun!
records.translation: Natutuwa akong gumagawa pa rin sila ng disenteng mga pelikula... Napakasaya ko!

records.source: I've never been a fan of scary movies, but I'll try to keep an open mind.
records.translation: Hindi ko kailanman nagustuhan ang mga nakakatakot na pelikula, pero susubukan kong maging bukas ang isip.

records.source: Is it over yet?$s
records.translation: Tapos na ba?$s

records.source: Evelyn is covering her eyes.
records.translation: Tinatakpan ni Evelyn ang kaniyang mga mata.

records.source: I had to close my eyes during most of it...$s
records.translation: Kinailangan kong ipikit ang mga mata ko sa halos buong palabas...$s

records.source: I grew up watching old sci-fi flicks, so I'm interested to see a modern take on the genre.
records.translation: Lumaki akong nanonood ng mga lumang pelikulang agham-piksiyon, kaya interesado akong makita ang makabagong bersiyon ng ganitong uri.

records.source: Hah! It wasn't what I expected, but I ended up really liking it! I really identified with Wumbus.$h
records.translation: Hah! Hindi iyon ang inaasahan ko, pero talagang nagustuhan ko rin iyon! Nakita ko talaga ang sarili ko kay Wumbus.$h

records.source: I'm usually working all the time, so it's really nice to do something like this.
records.translation: Karaniwan ay palagi akong nagtatrabaho, kaya napakasayang gumawa ng ganito.

records.source: Not bad! I wonder if they have any merchandise I could stock...
records.translation: Hindi masama! Iniisip ko kung mayroon silang anumang panindang maaari kong itinda...
